subject: MATHEMATICS
title: Greater, Less, or Equal
objective: Compare whole numbers by place value.
introduction: Milo is weighing two baskets of santol! Help him compare 4,210 and 4,201.

vocabulary.definition: To look at two numbers and tell which is greater, less, or equal.
A symbol or word that tells how many, like 4,210.
What a digit is worth by its position.

items.prompt: Which statement about comparing numbers is true?

options.text: Compare digits from the greatest place to the ones place.

items.explanation: Start at the greatest place and compare each digit until one is different, then continue to the next place if they are the same.
Both numbers have 4 thousands and 2 hundreds. Compare tens: 1 is greater than 0, so 4,210 > 4,201.

items.prompt: Which is NOT a good way to compare numbers?
items.explanation: Looking only at the ones digit can trick you: 4,210 > 4,201 even though 0 < 1. Compare from the greatest place.
Compare from the left: 4,210 and 4,201 both have 4 thousands and 2 hundreds, but 1 ten is greater than 0 tens, so 4,210 > 4,201.
2,999 has 2 thousands and 3,000 has 3 thousands, and 2 < 3, so 2,999 < 3,000.
